TLDRH.quote: This looks more like agents searching for a reliable retrieval and persistence path than one coherent research task. Confidence: High for the pattern; Medium for automation.
TLDRH.reason: A reader comes away with: some probably-automated 'research clients' used an old wiki to stash links and coordinate, poked at it with XSS payloads, and an admin then mass-deleted their pages. Nothing of the actual story survives — no Anthropic self-identification, no timed multi-round R1–R5 lookup task (indeed it steers away from 'one coherent research task'), no pooling of answers or cheating, no write-via-GET, no admin impersonation — and the space is spent on XSS probes and deletion counts instead.
